title: Transient solvency-invariant window: topUp/setTargetAPY recompute without a preceding pull() over-states rewardBudget by the un-pulled mintDebt
plausibility: n/a (no value-extraction path; self-healing by construction)
description: When mintDebt > 0 sits un-pulled at the dispatcher hook and topUp/setTargetAPY recompute without a preceding pull(), _recomputeSchedule sizes rewardBudget on V = balance + mintDebt (NFTStaker.sol:403-405), so rewardBudget + committedDebt transiently over-states the on-chain balance by exactly the un-pulled mintDebt. The Critical Invariant 'Solvency: balance == rewardBudget + committedDebt holds at ALL times' is thus only eventually-consistent: strict equality is restored on the next _syncBudget/pull(). PoC-confirmed (F02 scenario).
impact: No directly extractable value. The over-statement is phantom: _safePay (L510) gates every payout on actual balanceOf and reverts on a real shortfall, so the phantom budget is NOT drainable. Self-heals on the next stake/unstake/claim/pullAndRefresh (_syncBudget -> pull() restores strict equality). The only adverse tail is a contingent, owner-recoverable claim-DoS if the dispatcher hook is rotated/broken within the window so the assumed mintDebt never materialises.
attackPath: 1. mintDebt accrues un-pulled at the dispatcher hook.
2. Owner calls setTargetAPY or topUp (neither pulls first) -> recompute over-sizes rewardBudget by mintDebt.
3. The over-statement is phantom: _safePay (L510) gates every payout on actual balanceOf and reverts on a real shortfall, so the phantom budget is NOT drainable.
4. Self-heals: the next stake/unstake/claim/pullAndRefresh runs _syncBudget -> pull() and restores strict equality.
recommendation: Re-word the Solvency Critical Invariant to 'eventually-consistent: strict on-balance equality holds after every _syncBudget; between a config recompute and the next pull() the ledger may over-state balance by the un-pulled mintDebt, which is never payable because _safePay gates on actual balance.' Optionally call pull()/_syncBudget before the recompute in topUp/setTargetAPY (weigh against the intentional dispatcher-hook-independence property, Feature Spec item 7).

poc.result: ledger over-states balance by exactly mintDebt; _safePay still gates; pull() restores strict equality
